title: design profile
description: The harness's only knowledge of the project it judges. Every string may contain ${VAR} or ${VAR:-default}, expanded from the environment at load.

sector.description: What kind of product this is. The critics judge against the conventions of this sector, not against the average of the web.

out.description: Where runs are written, relative to the profile's directory.

brand.description: The half of the contract that says what this product is. The identity lens judges against it — a violet accent is not slop if violet is declared here.

benchmarks.description: Products to copy and patterns to refuse, by name. A refusal that appears in the pixels is a finding with a citation rather than an opinion.

tokens.description: Path to a DTCG design tokens file, when the project has one.

auth.description: Personas, as driver-neutral steps. Keys are persona names referenced by surfaces.

items.description: One verb per step: open | fill | type | click | press | hover | wait | eval | cookies | assert. `assert` is the only step that can fail the recipe, and every persona should end with one.

assert.description: CSS selector that must exist. Without it a failed sign-in silently produces screenshots of the login page.

auth.description: Persona name, or omit for anonymous.

assert.description: CSS selector proving this is the page you meant.

mask.description: Selectors painted flat before the capture: clocks, live counters, avatars.

viewports.description: Subset of the declared viewports. Omit for all.

sensors.description: Default: every in-page sensor plus console. `axe` and `vitals` come from the driver and need the page to paint — check `design doctor` first.

budgets.description: Where a fact becomes a defect, for this project. A sensor reports what is true; these decide what is wrong.

ignoreHttpsErrors.description: For a local CA. Judging pixels and testing TLS are different jobs — do not let this stand in for a trust check.

vision.description: Can this CLI open an image? A visual lens is refused on a runtime declared blind.

assign.description: lens → runtime, or lens → [runtimes] for an ensemble. Omit for round-robin.

quorum.description: Refutations needed to drop a finding.

denyTokens.description: Words that must never appear inside the harness tree. This is how the portability test names your project without the harness containing it.

notes.description: Anything the critics should know that is not visible in the pixels.

locator.description: One of testid | css | text | role(+name).
